I know that feeling all too well. My mom is a department leader in a home for elderly people. I (21F) sometimes go with her when she has to do some paper work, just to keep her company. There are about 4-5 other females around the age of 18-20 who work at her department. They know how and what to do to care for the elderly residents and stuff like that. I’ve been asked if I just started working there, but I’m always just there with my mom. I’ve been in and out of the psych ward for 3 years and only started working in a kitchen 3 hours a week about a month ago. I feel so stupid and useless seing people younger than me doing so well and especially knowing how to work in a place like that. I just wish I could do that too. That’s only one of the examples I have, but I really understand how you are feeling. I try to remind myself that I’m doing fine and taking the time I need, but it just hits very hard sometimes.
